# ERC-3643 key-control census

> A recountable, read-only census of who owns ERC-3643 token issuances on Polygon and Ethereum. Open data, open code, a one-command recount, a selftest that plants errors, and a weekly time series. It measures the owner role and the agent role, defines control levels, and states what it does not show.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/holistis/erc3643-key-census/blob/main/README.md): the numbers, what was measured, what it does not show, how to recount
- [Control levels](https://github.com/holistis/erc3643-key-census/blob/main/LEVELS.md): Level 0 and Level 1, defined by the weakest role holder, with what a level does not say
- [Data summary](https://github.com/holistis/erc3643-key-census/blob/main/data/summary.json): the counts behind the numbers, with the measurement blocks
- [Time series](https://github.com/holistis/erc3643-key-census/blob/main/history/series.csv): one row per weekly measurement

## Reference

- [Notes for AI agents](https://github.com/holistis/erc3643-key-census/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how to quote the numbers without overclaiming
- [Recounts and corrections](https://github.com/holistis/erc3643-key-census/blob/main/RECOUNTS.md): independent recounts, with credit
- [Citation](https://github.com/holistis/erc3643-key-census/blob/main/CITATION.cff)
- [Note on tokenizen.nl](https://tokenizen.nl/notes/who-holds-the-keys-of-erc-3643-issuances)
